summary: Practise crisis data checks, QGIS impact mapping and response prioritization. Explore the five-day intermediate course and its applied outputs.
lede: Big data analytics for crisis management helps response teams turn incoming incident information into operational assessments and decision-ready reports. For crisis information officers, emergency operations analysts and humanitarian response managers, it develops practical skills to check data quality in Excel, map impacts in QGIS, compare needs with response capacity and communicate uncertainty in situation briefs.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is for professionals who turn crisis information into operational assessments, coordination products and resource decisions. It suits roles that already work with incident or response data and need a more consistent analytical workflow.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with incident, emergency-response or humanitarian programme information is expected. No programming is required; learners should be comfortable using spreadsheets. Bring a laptop with Excel and QGIS installed.
